description: Na₂S₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-59°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.62 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-63°. There are three shorter (1.44 Å) and one longer (1.67 Å) S-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two S atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one S atom.
